speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with feeding intolerance and bilious vomiting; tell me, how many days old are you?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, 3050-g (6-lb 12-oz) male, six hours post delivery. The newborn has had several episodes of bilious vomiting and is intolerant to feeding since birth. Was born at term following an uncomplicated pregnancy, though the mother missed several prenatal checkups. The patient's older brother underwent surgery for pyloric stenosis as an infant.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Intestinal Obstruction (likely Malrotation with Midgut Volvulus or Distal Intestinal Obstruction Syndrome) given bilious vomiting in a 6-hour-old newborn with no mention of abdominal distension or other specific signs yet.
